prompt: Create an original 150 second gamelan-inspired instrumental instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: metallophones, soft gong, bamboo flute. Style: cyclic interlocking metallic patterns with long gong punctuation. Tempo approximately 76 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A serene and gentle instrumental piece featuring wind instruments like flute and clarinet, accompanied by plucked strings and light percussion, creating a calming and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而温柔的器乐曲，以长笛和单簧管等管乐器为主，伴随着拨弦乐器和轻柔的打击乐，营造出平静而沉思的氛围。
